title: Carlson's 1995 Warren Wilson College lectures proposing a Younger Dryas impact

tellings.quote: I gave re five lectures at Warren Wilson College in 1995. I believe it was [clears throat] where I basically talked about the younger dus, the mass extinctions, the rapid climate change.

plain: A researcher named Randall Carlson says that in 1995 he gave five lectures at Warren Wilson College in North Carolina proposing that a cosmic impact lay behind the Younger Dryas, a sudden return to cold at the end of the last ice age, along with mass extinctions and rapid climate change. Carlson tells Michels this himself, to show he was putting forward the impact idea that early.
